about: The Anima Christi is a Christ-centered devotional prayer built from brief invocations. It asks Christ’s soul to sanctify the speaker, His body to save, His blood to inebriate, the water from His side to wash, and His Passion to strengthen. It then asks Jesus to hear, to hide the speaker within His wounds, not to let the speaker be parted from Him, to defend, to call at the hour of death, and to bid the speaker come to Him and praise Him with the saints forever.

seg.tr: Water from the side of Christ, wash me.

ex.w025: “Exáudi” asks not merely for audibility but for a favorable hearing of the petition.

seg.tr: Do not permit me to be separated from You.
Defend me from the evil enemy.

ex.w039: Tradition understands this enemy as the evil spirit.

seg.tr: At the hour of my death, call me.
And bid me come to You,
that I may praise You with Your saints
